front: What is the single source of authoritative nongovernmental U.S. GAAP?
back: The **FASB Accounting Standards Codification (ASC)**. SEC rules/releases are also authoritative for SEC registrants. Concepts Statements are **not** authoritative.

front: FASB vs. GASB vs. FAF vs. PCC — one line each
back: **FASB**: GAAP for businesses & NFPs. **GASB**: state & local governments. **FAF**: oversees/funds both boards, writes no standards. **PCC**: proposes private-company alternatives the FASB may endorse.

front: The two fundamental qualitative characteristics and their components
back: **Relevance**: predictive value, confirmatory value, materiality. **Faithful representation**: complete, neutral, free from error.
**Comparability, Verifiability, Timeliness, Understandability** (mnemonic: *CVTU* — "Can Verify Timely Understanding"). Pervasive constraint: **cost**.
A **present right** of an entity **to an economic benefit**.
A **present obligation** of an entity **to transfer an economic benefit**.

front: Going concern evaluation period under ASC 205-40
back: **One year after the date the financial statements are issued** (or available to be issued).
**No.** Deliberate understatement violates **neutrality** (part of faithful representation).
